name: Upscale model (ComfyUI)
description: An upscale model from the server's models/upscale_models folder (ESRGAN, UltraSharp, DAT, ...), picked under Settings as Model; the model enlarges by its own factor. On the selection, its box goes out at its own size, without a fill or the reference layers, and the node's stitch fits the answer back into the box: a sharper detail pass at the document's resolution. On the whole picture, the base goes out alone and the answer becomes the new picture, every layer scaled along; a cut-out picture comes back opaque, black where it was transparent. The whole picture may be at most 2048 px on the long side, so a 4x model answers at most 8192.
